interface.title: ProteinViz
interface.field: Molecular biology / drug discovery: disease–target–pathway–structure bioinformatics
interface.stage_of_work: Early hypothesis generation and target triage, before experiments
interface.what_it_is_for: Go from a disease, protein or gene list to its associated targets, STRING interaction networks, enriched pathways, known drugs, AlphaFold confidence and the interface residues of solved PDB complexes, all pulled live from public databases and shareable by permalink.

data.source: Live queries to public databases (Open Targets, STRING, UniProt, AlphaFold DB, RCSB PDB); uploaded example files and a pasted gene list were used only on the Your data page, and the EGCG page used its bundled ChEMBL 37 dataset
data.note: Most data came live from Open Targets, STRING, UniProt, AlphaFold DB and RCSB PDB, with retrieval timestamps shown (e.g. Alzheimer MONDO_0004975, Parkinson MONDO_0005180, TP53/MDM2, APP, PINK1/PRKN). On the Your data page I uploaded example_ppi.csv and example_compound_target.csv and also pasted a 6-gene list. The EGCG page uses its bundled ChEMBL 37 dataset.

features.name: Enrichment bar chart with category filter
features.general: Test a gene set for over-represented annotation terms, choose which annotation sources to show, and read the genes behind each term
features.specific: STRING functional enrichment shown as −log10 FDR bars, with a Categories multiselect (KEGG, Reactome, GO process, WikiPathways, Diseases), hover tooltips listing genes and a term table. A dedicated Download enrichment (CSV) button exists only on the Network & pathways and Your data pages; on the Disease explorer the only download is the table-toolbar icon, which produced no file
steps: provide a gene set (disease top targets, network neighbourhood, pasted list or uploaded table)
add or remove annotation categories
hover a bar to see term ID, FDR and member genes
read the term table
on the Network or Your data page, press Download enrichment (CSV)

features.name: Evidence-coloured interaction network with confidence threshold
features.general: Draw a network of links between items, keep only links above a confidence level, and colour each link by its strongest kind of evidence
features.specific: STRING network (Plotly) whose edges are coloured by strongest channel (Experiments / Curated databases / Text mining) with edge hover scores. The Disease explorer's Interaction network tab has only a Minimum confidence slider; the Network & pathways page adds a Partners slider, a functional/physical toggle, an edge table and Download edges (CSV)
steps: seed with the disease's top targets (Disease page) or one protein (Network page)
set confidence (low → highest) — both pages
on the Network page only: switch functional vs physical and set the number of partners
hover an edge for combined score and evidence channel
on the Network page only: download edges CSV
serves_tasks: See how the top genes interact and keep only well-supported links
Explore one protein's interaction partners and what pathways they point to

features.name: Interface residue calculator with 3D viewer
features.general: Pick a solved structure and two of its chains, set a distance cutoff, and list and highlight the residues in contact
features.specific: Choose the PDB Entry and Chain pair and set Cutoff (Å, 3.5–8). Contacts are computed with gemmi ContactSearch and shown as red sticks in Mol*, with a residue table (min distance, contact count) and Download interface (CSV)
steps: enter the protein pair (or a PDB ID)
choose an entry from the list of complexes, ordered by resolution
choose a chain pair
drag the cutoff slider
rotate or zoom the Mol* view
download the interface CSV
serves_tasks: Find solved 3D complexes of the pair and work out which residues touch
Go straight to a known structure entry

features.name: Predicted-structure confidence panel (pLDDT + PAE)

features.specific: AlphaFold model (A) tab: model ID, mean pLDDT, Mol* cartoon in the four pLDDT bands, and a predicted aligned error heatmap with box zoom and residue-pair tooltips
steps: enter protein A
open the AlphaFold model tab
read the mean pLDDT and coloured cartoon
drag a box on the PAE heatmap to zoom a region
hover for scored/aligned residue and PAE
serves_tasks: Judge how reliable a predicted structure is, residue by residue
